			}

				modifier = {
					add = 10
					has_trait = brave
				}
				add_prestige = 100
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_cattle_rich_modifier years = 3 }
			}
			35 = {
				desc = eir.out.cattle_lost
				scope:eir_raid_county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_cattle_raided_modifier years = 4 } }
				add_prestige = -25
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0054.b
		trigger = {
			learning >= 8
		}
		add_prestige = 25
		add_gold = minor_gold_value
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0054.c
		stress_impact = {
			forgiving = minor_stress_impact_gain
			vengeful = miniscule_stress_impact_loss
		}
		add_gold = medium_gold_value
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_raider_infamy_modifier years = 5 }
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0054.d
		stress_impact = {
			wrathful = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		scope:eir_raid_county = { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_cattle_raided_modifier years = 4 } }
		add_prestige = -50
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
	}
}
